name: Collab Capital
identity_check: Confirmed as collab.capital, the Atlanta VC founded by Jewel Burks Solomon and Barry Givens (AJC and TechCrunch headlines in search results); its own newsroom announces the $75M Fund II. Portfolio: SparkCharge, River Health, Goodr, Hairbrella. Not Collab (collab.com creator platform) or other 'Collab' funds.

pages.title: Collab Capital Closes $75M Fund II, Scales Its Vision for "Shared Prosperity"
SparkCharge raises $30M to help fleets electrify without commitments

website.snippet: the building blocks of shared prosperity

thesis_text.value: Backs early-stage startups addressing foundational needs in work, healthcare and community infrastructure, led by founders closest to the problem.
thesis_text.snippet: founders closest to the problem are best positioned to solve it

stated_sectors.snippet: Economic Mobility, Healthcare Access, and Community Infrastructure (power, transportation, broadband, housing, and food)

funds.name: Collab Capital Fund II
funds.snippet: Announced June 11, 2025: $75 million in committed capital. With Fund I, total assets under management reach $125 million.

company.name: SparkCharge
company.description: Mobile, off-grid EV charging for fleets, sold as charging-as-a-service.

rounds.snippet: with participation from Cleveland Avenue, Collab Capital, Elemental Impact, MarcyPen, and non sibi ventures

open_items: Only 1 round recorded. River Health Series A (Jan 2025) and A0 appear only in Collab's own portfolio listing and aggregators (VCBacked, CB Insights); no round page naming Collab found. Collab's portfolio page gives no round dates.
SparkCharge headline says $30M (TechCrunch: $15.5M equity plus a $15M venture loan from Horizon Technology Finance); amount recorded as the $15.5M equity.

Fund I ($50M, 2021-05-26 per lead list; sources vary $50M-$51M, launched 2020) not confirmed on a fetched page; only Fund II recorded. Fund II numbers in the release are 'about 30 companies over five years, 40% reserved for follow-ons'.
HQ Atlanta is from the press-release dateline, not an explicit statement; the site's Contact link is a placeholder.
